description: A daily photo on a foto-log.com fotolog.

main.description: One photo on a fotolog. The record key is the uploadDate followed by a two-digit sequence number for that day, YYYY-MM-DD-NN (NN from 01 to 99), e.g. 2026-10-06-01. How many photos an account may post per day is decided by the app, not by this schema.

post.description: The app.bsky.feed.post that shares this photo. Replies to it are the photo's guestbook.

uploadDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the photo was posted, in the poster's time zone. The record key starts with this date.

displayDate.description: Calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) the photo is shown under. Always equals uploadDate for now.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name of the poster when the photo was posted, e.g. America/New_York.

aspectRatio.description: Width and height of the image. Only the ratio matters.
